# shaders (utils)

## Summary
Pure GLSL source strings for the four render passes — no imports, no runtime dependencies. `VOXEL_VSH`/`VOXEL_FSH` morph every instanced cube between its three addresses (measured tree, Itten sphere, flattened atlas page) and light it; `HALO_VSH`/`HALO_FSH` add a soft additive glow behind each voxel in 3D; `GRID_VSH`/`GRID_FSH` draw the LINEAR-scale page's complete synthetic grid; `RING_VSH`/`RING_FSH` mark where the measured chips actually sit inside that ideal field.

## Import
```js
import { VOXEL_VSH, VOXEL_FSH } from '../utils/shaders';
```
